data.title: 诗怀雅 · 花市挑选
data.description: 她挑中一枝颜色鲜亮的花，请店主包好。临走前，她又回头替朋友选了一束。
data.promptProse: Navigating the vibrant corridor of a festive flower market, Swire holds an elegant budding peach blossom branch against her shoulder. Rows of potted orchids, miniature citrus trees, and fluttering crimson banners glow warmly under strings of market lanterns.
data.animaCaption: Holding the flowering peach branch upright, she inspects the tightness of the pink buds with practiced, festive enthusiasm.
